title: Practice 8: Accusative endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.prompt: The handsome prince fell in love with a very beautiful princess.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «принцессу»: accusative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
The adjective agrees with «воду»: accusative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
The adjective agrees with «крючок»: accusative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: You're just broadcasting cultural propaganda your education had filled you with.
exercises.ru: Ты лишь транслируешь ___ пропаганду, которой тебя зарядило полученное образование.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «пропаганду»: accusative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Дэн не хотел возвращаться в ___ (сиротский) приют.
exercises.prompt: Dan didn't want to go back to an orphanage.

The adjective agrees with «школу»: accusative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: В ___ (девяностый) годы Интернет называли ещё "информационным суперхайвеем".
exercises.prompt: The Internet was also called the information superhighway in the 1990s.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «годы»: accusative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He is active although he is very old.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «возраст»: accusative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
